description:
[Skin Lab] A Skin Lab 3D viewer link for one item or skin. Answers "can I see this skin in 3D?". With a known item and a processed skin: `available_in_3d: true`, the
`viewer_url` that opens rust.wiki/skin-lab with it on, and `embed` ({o, mode} - the same piece the "View in 3D"
card on the item and skin pages loads). A real skin that has no 3D textures yet gives `available_in_3d: false`
with the reason and a `fallback_url` showing the item's default look. Unknown items are 404 with suggestions. Use when someone asks to SEE a skin or item: returns a rust.wiki/skin-lab link that opens it in 3D (available_in_3d=false says why not, with a fallback link). Share viewer_url with the user.

attachments.description: Guns only: comma-separated attachment shortnames, e.g. `weapon.mod.holosight,weapon.mod.silencer`.

item.description: Item shortname or name. Optional when `skin` is an itemdefid.

mode.description: `outfit` (on the player), `weapon` (the item on its own) or `pov` (first person, guns and tools). Default: `outfit` for worn items, `weapon` otherwise.

skin.description: Skin itemdefid or name (default look when left out).

name: skinlab_link
title: A Skin Lab 3D viewer link for one item or skin
